70:11.text: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.

70:12.text: And his wife and his brother

70:13.text: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.

70:14.text: And whoever is on earth entirely

70:17.text: It invites he who turned his back

70:21.text: And when good touches him, withholding

70:23.text: Those who are constant in their prayer

70:24.text: And those within whose wealth is a known right

70:25.text: For the petitioner and the deprived -

70:26.text: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

70:27.text: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

70:28.text: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

70:29.text: And those who guard their private parts

70:30.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,
for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

70:31.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

70:32.text: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.

70:33.text: And those who are in their testimonies upright

70:38.text: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

70:39.text: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
